title: B2: compact delta packets in planner_runs — decision_packet/grouped_packet delegate to planner_packet.build with changes since the previous decision, structured scout findings, memory titles; escalation packet on re-escalation; packet size into telemetry (P4, P10)
spec:
Why: planner_runs.decision_packet (planner_runs.py:43-107) and grouped_packet (1063-1090) rebuild a per-point packet with the full spawn packet inventory and 300-char scout summaries, no delta, no memory, no required-output section. planner_packet (merged, orchestrator/planner_packet.py) provides build(sections, *, goal, previous, changes, scout_findings, memory_hits, cap_chars) -> {text, chars, est_tokens, hash, sections, truncated, delta} and escalation_packet(*, goal, original_sections, opus_decision, unresolved, conflicting_evidence, scout_findings, memory_hits, reason, cap_chars); B1 v3 (T-0741) makes run_group sections 4-tuples (point, ctx, route, classification) and records launch rows.
What (planner_runs.py only; new tests in tests/test_planner_runs_packets.py; existing tests keep passing):
- _packet_sections(sections) -> list of planner_packet section dicts: for each (point, ctx, route, classification): task = bus.get(point task id) for held points else None; reviews = [{path, line, issue} for every comment in failures.rejecting_reviews(task)] (max 10) when task; failures = the text of (task.resume_hint or task.result).failures when task; depends_on_statuses = [{id, status} for dep in task.depends_on via bus.get, KeyError -> status "missing"].
- _previous_launch(goal_id) -> the planner_runs record of this goal with the latest started_at that has a launch_id, or None; _changes_since(goal_id, cursor) -> list of {"task", "field", "from", "to", "ts"} from bus events with seq > cursor for the goal's children, fields status, hold_reason, merged_into only (from = the previous known value within the scan, to = new), newest last, max 20; cursor = previous["cursor_at_launch"].
- _scout_findings(goal_id) -> scout_evidence.normalize_findings(scout result) concatenated over the goal's done scout children (max 10 entries, highest confidence first); _memory_hits(goal) -> up to 10 {title} from scout_evidence.memory_recall(goal title, root=STATE) guarded by try/except Exception -> [].
- grouped_packet(sections) -> planner_packet.build(_packet_sections(sections), goal=bus.get(goal_id), previous={"state_version": prev.get("state_version")} if prev else None, changes=_changes_since(...) if prev else None, scout_findings=..., memory_hits=..., cap_chars=[planner].decision_packet_chars default 6000)["text"]; the full build result is kept on the module-level _LAST_PACKET_META so run_group stores packet_chars, packet_hash, packet_delta, packet_truncated on the records and passes packet_chars=build["chars"] to planner_telemetry.record_launch (replacing len(prompt)). decision_packet(goal_id, kind, payload, repo_path) (legacy single-point path) builds one section via build_ctx + planner_taxonomy.classify and returns build(...)["text"]; the legacy inventory and 300-char summaries are removed.
- Escalation (P10): in run_group, when ctx.get("reescalation") is True and a planner_shadow row exists for this goal's previous launch (read runs/sched/planner_shadow.jsonl rows with goal_id, latest started_at), the prompt is rendered from planner_packet.escalation_packet(goal=..., original_sections=..., opus_decision={proposed_action, summary, tasks_proposed, confidence, needs_fable, unresolved} from that row, unresolved=row unresolved, conflicting_evidence=None, scout_findings, memory_hits, reason=";".join(hard_reasons), cap_chars) instead of build; record packet_kind "escalation" vs "decision" on the records and in the launch row's extra field packet_kind (add the key to the record_launch call; planner_telemetry.record_launch accepts it via its bounded row — if record_launch rejects unknown kwargs, store packet_kind on the planner_runs record only).
- The rendered prompt still goes through spawn.render("planner-decision", packet=text).
acceptance: tests/test_planner_runs_packets.py::test_first_decision_packet_has_sections_and_no_inventory — grouped_packet for a scouts_done goal with two done scouts and a patched memory_recall yields text containing 'first Planner decision for this goal', the Scout findings and Memory sections, no 'Spawn packet' section, and len(text) <= decision_packet_chars

tests/test_planner_runs_packets.py::test_delta_packet_lists_changes_since_previous_launch — after a first launch record with cursor_at_launch, a child task changing status and hold_reason produces a packet whose Changes section lists both fields with from/to and the previous state_version; the record stores packet_delta True and packet_chars equal to the build's chars, and the launch row's packet_chars matches

tests/test_planner_runs_packets.py::test_held_section_carries_failures_reviews_and_dependency_statuses — a held task with resume_hint failures, a rejecting review with two comments and one missing dependency renders failures (capped), the two comments as path:line issue, and 'missing' for the dependency

tests/test_planner_runs_packets.py::test_escalation_packet_used_on_reescalation — with ctx reescalation True and a prior planner_shadow row for the goal, the rendered prompt contains 'Escalation reason:' and 'Opus proposed decision', no 'Changes since previous decision' section, and the record has packet_kind escalation; without a shadow row the ordinary build is used

tests/test_planner_runs_packets.py::test_legacy_decision_packet_delegates_and_caps — decision_packet(goal_id, 'held', payload) returns planner_packet text (header line present) within the cap and never includes spawn.packet inventory text; existing tests in tests/test_planner_runs.py that exercise decision_packet keep passing

constraints.interface_contract: grouped_packet(sections) and decision_packet(goal_id, kind, payload, repo_path) return planner_packet.build(...)['text']; build meta (chars, hash, delta, truncated) stored on the planner_runs records and packet_chars passed to planner_telemetry.record_launch; escalation_packet used when ctx.reescalation and a prior planner_shadow row exist; helpers _packet_sections, _previous_launch, _changes_since, _scout_findings, _memory_hits; cap from [planner].decision_packet_chars.

result.summary: superseded by B2 v2 after spec review request_changes (tests/test_goals.py DecisionPacket suite in scope and rewritten for the planner_packet format; _changes_since reads the events table directly for the goal's task ids with seq > cursor instead of the globally capped bus.events page)

spec_review_risks.issue: DecisionPacket suite (lines 616-707) asserts the legacy decision_packet text format ("Task title:", "Scout summaries:", "Spawn packet:" inventory, exact "Goal id:"/"Payload id:" lines, exact len==cap slicing). The spec removes all of this in favor of planner_packet.build()'s section format but never adds tests/test_goals.py to scope or acknowledges these 5 tests will break.

_changes_since is specced to call bus.events(since=cursor, task_ids=children) for the Changes section, but bus.events applies its default limit=200 to a globally-ordered page (all goals) before filtering by task_ids. On a busy multi-goal orchestrator this can silently return zero rows for a goal whose children did change, since the goal's events fall outside the first 200 global rows since cursor.
